title: 第22章 巫师语
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
画面中浮现出一个站在山巅的身影。

    那身影抬起右手，轻轻下压。

    远处，一座山峰轰然崩塌，无数巨石滚落，尘土遮天蔽日。

    【已是凡俗无法理解的存在。】

    【若正式巫师愿意，可以一己之力，在数日内覆灭任何凡人帝国。】

    伊森的瞳孔微微收缩。

    覆灭帝国？

    数日之内？

    他知道正式巫师很强，但没想到强到这种程度。

    画面继续播放，但接下来的内容就平淡了许多。

    超凡生物的分类：魔兽、灵植、死灵、元素生命......

    超凡材料的辨识：魔兽血液、骨骼、皮毛，灵植的根茎叶花果，各类矿石、晶石......

    超凡物品的等级：学徒级、正式巫师级、更高层次......

    超凡知识的危险性：错误的符文会导致能量失控，错误的配方会导致爆炸，错误的实验会引来不可预知的灾难......

    伊森坐在那里，目光盯着面前的光幕，一动不动。

    百倍的学习速度，让这些信息如同刻印一般，迅速而深刻地烙印在他脑海中。

    时间一分一秒流逝。

    不知过了多久。

    光幕上的画面骤然停止。

    那些流转的影像，那些跳动的文字，全部凝固在最后一帧。

    那个温和的男声再次响起：

    “巫师与超凡，到此结束。”

    “记住，”

    “巫师是看见真相的人。”

    “但真相，往往很危险。”

    光幕开始消散。

    从边缘开始，那淡蓝色的光芒一点一点黯淡下去，化作细碎的光点，融入空气中。

    几息后，所有光芒彻底消失。

    桌面恢复了原本的模样，那些细密的纹路也黯淡下去，仿佛从未亮起过。

    周围的新生们三三两两地起身，有人还在低声议论着刚才课程里的内容。

    “正式巫师能覆灭帝国......这也太......”

    “我要是能成为正式巫师，家里那些欺负过咱们家族的......”

    “别做梦了，先活过十年再说吧。”

    伊森没有参与这些讨论，只是安静地坐着，听着周围那些或惊叹、或憧憬、或恐惧的声音。

    他真正在琢磨的是另一件事。

    这节免费课是光幕自动播放，没人讲解，没人答疑。

    那其他收费的课呢？
content_en:
A figure standing on the top of a mountain appeared in the picture.

    The figure raised his right hand and pressed it down gently.

    In the distance, a mountain peak suddenly collapsed, countless boulders rolled down, and dust covered the sky and the sun.

    [It is already an existence that ordinary people cannot understand. 】

    [If a formal wizard is willing, he can single-handedly destroy any mortal empire within a few days. 】

    Ethan's pupils shrank slightly.

    Destroy the empire?

    Within a few days?

    He knew that official wizards were very strong, but he didn't expect them to be this strong.

    The screen continued to play, but what followed was much duller.

    Classification of extraordinary creatures: Warcraft, spiritual plants, undead, elemental life...

    Identification of extraordinary materials: blood, bones, fur of monsters, roots, leaves, flowers and fruits of spiritual plants, various ores, crystals...

    Levels of extraordinary items: apprentice level, official wizard level, higher level...

    The dangers of extraordinary knowledge: Wrong runes can cause energy to go out of control, wrong formulas can cause explosions, wrong experiments can lead to unpredictable disasters...

    Ethan sat there, staring at the light curtain in front of him, motionless.

    The hundred-fold learning speed made this information imprinted in his mind quickly and deeply like an imprint.

    Time passes minute by minute.

    I don’t know how much time passed.

    The picture on the light screen suddenly stopped.

    Those flowing images and those beating words are all frozen in the last frame.

    The gentle male voice sounded again:

    "Wizards and Supernaturals, that ends here."

    "Remember,"

    "A wizard is someone who sees the truth."

    "But the truth is often dangerous."

    The light curtain began to dissipate.

    Starting from the edge, the light blue light dimmed little by little, turning into tiny points of light and blending into the air.

    After a few breaths, all the light disappeared completely.

    The tabletop returned to its original appearance, and the fine lines dimmed, as if it had never been lit up before.

    The freshmen around them stood up in twos and threes, and some were still whispering about the content of the course just now.

    "Formal wizards can destroy the empire...this is too..."

    "If I could become an official wizard, those people in my family who have bullied our family..."

    "Stop dreaming, let's live for ten years first."

    Ethan did not participate in these discussions, he just sat quietly, listening to the voices around him that were filled with wonder, admiration, or fear.

    What he was really thinking about was something else.

    This free class is automatically played by a light curtain, with no one explaining or answering questions.

    What about other paid courses?
